notes: Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell for targeted poison effects such as Triple Shot; reserve Death's Advance for the Uncoiled Writhe knockback.
Anti-Magic Zone can cover coordinated group damage including Mass Envenom when its cast is not stopped.
Anti-Magic Shell reduces Lightblossom Beam damage and can prevent Bloodthorn Roots when timed before application.
Wraith Walk is the recovery option for an existing Bloodthorn root; Death's Advance does not remove it.
Activate Death's Advance during Frozen Tempest to resist its outward push while remaining in the safe eye.
Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell to prevent Corroding Spittle's damage-over-time effect and reduce Demonic Rage damage.
Plan Anti-Magic Zone on boss-wide magic damage rather than holding it indefinitely for a perfect full-party stack.
Death's Advance answers Black Hole, Monstrous Roar, and Void Cascade forced movement; Anti-Magic Shell can prevent Cosmic Crash's damage-over-time effect.
Treat Death Grip as displacement for susceptible enemies, not as a normal spell-school interrupt.
Use Death's Advance to ignore Gale Force's push and Anti-Magic Shell to extend a safe Lightning Spire soak.
Death Grip helps cluster Avatar adds; it does not replace Mind Freeze on interruptible casts.
Grip Animated Gold away from the Golden Serpent and group Mchimba's mummies for efficient cleave.
Control Undead is generally a poor Unholy choice because it dismisses the permanent ghoul; Frost or Blood can exploit that niche more safely.
The source lists no dungeon-specific Unholy trick here; retain baseline cast control, mob grouping, Anti-Magic Zone, and Raise Ally without claiming a special interaction.

recommendations: Use Mind Freeze first; Blinding Sleet or Death Grip can stop a remaining susceptible cast in an emergency.
There is no dedicated utility answer; preserve priority damage for the emissary spawn.
Death's Advance helps reach and intercept orbiting orbs without a talent swap.
Anti-Magic Shell can prevent the effect, but doing so also forfeits its positive benefit; use it only when group removal will not arrive.
Unyielding Will can let Anti-Magic Shell remove an existing effect, while Death Strike can help meet the healing requirement.
